headline: Preprint reports AI-assisted reproduction and robustness screening across 20 SEER studies
summary: The authors introduce SEER-Repro, a curated benchmark of 20 published studies using the U.S. Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) cancer registry, and report that an AI coding agent reproduced 1,694 of 2,190 atomic claims (77.4%). A separate agentic analysis pipeline flagged 55 of 579 reproduced findings (9.5%) for expert review. One coauthor manually examined 10 flagged cases: nine did not establish a consequential change under a defensible alternative, while one needs further statistical review. These are paper-reported results from one curated biomedical data corpus, not independent proof of general clinical audit capability.
